name: 81132 · Del Norte, CO
findings: ZIP 81132 (Del Norte) has 14 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (64%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 7 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 81132 (Del Norte) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 81132 (Del Norte) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 7% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
